verses.en: Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.
verses.sm: Faauta mai ia; outou e, tamaoaiga, ia outou fetagisi ma wo ona o puapuaga e 00 mai ia te outou.

verses.en: Your riches are corrupted, and your garments are motheaten.
verses.sm: Ua pala la outou oloa, ua atiatia o outou ofu i mogamoga;

verses.en: Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.
verses.sm: ua elea a outou auro ma ario; E fai foi ma molimau ia te outou O latou ele, e “aina ai o outou tino pei o se au. Ua outou faaputu mea i ona aso e gata ai.

verses.en: Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of the Lord of sabaoth.
verses.sm: Faauta, o le totogi o e galulue, e na faaputu le fua o outou fanua, ua taofia e outou, ua alaga ia; o le alaga foi o e na selesele saito ua faafofogaina lava e le Alii o “au.

verses.en: Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.
verses.sm: Ua outou nonofo i le nuu ma le sololelei, ma le fiafia i la le tino; ua fafagaina outou e outou, faapei o manu i le aso e fafasi ai.

verses.en: Ye have condemned and killed the just; and he doth not resist you.
verses.sm: Ua outou faasala ma fasioti lē amiotonu, ua le tetee mai o ia ia te outou.

verses.en: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.
verses.sm: O lenei, le au uso e, onosai ia seia 00 i le afio mai o le Alii. Faauta, e faatali lē galue fanua i le fua aoga o le eleele, e faatalitali i ai, seia maua le uaga muamua ma lē mulimuli.

verses.en: Be ye also patient; stablish your hearts: for the coming of the Lord draweth nigh.
verses.sm: Ia onosai foi outou, ia faatumauina o outou loto, aua ua latalata le afio mai o le Alii.

verses.en: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest ye be condemned: behold, the judge standeth before the door.
verses.sm: Le au uso e, aua tou te femuimuiai, neʻi faamasinoina outou; faauta, ua tu mai le faamasino i luma o le faitotoa.

verses.en: Take, my brethren, the prophets, who have spoken in the name of the Lord, for an example of suffering affliction, and of patience.
verses.sm: to O'u uso E, ia outou faaaʻoaʻo i le faatoatoa i le leaga, atoa ma le onosai o le au perofeta, e na tautala mai i le suafa o le Alii.

verses.en: Behold, we count them happy which endure. Ye have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the end of the Lord; that the Lord is very pitiful, and of tender mercy.
verses.sm: ti Faauta, ua tatou taʻuamuia i e onosai. Ua outou faalogologo i le I.PETERU 1 onosai o lopu, ua outou iloa foi le iuga i la le Alii, ina ua mutimuti vale tele le Alii ma le alofa naunau.

verses.en: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.
verses.sm: O°u uso e, e muamua lava i mea uma lenei, aua lava ne“ outou tauto, po o i le lagi, po o i le fanua, po o se tasi lava tautoga; a e tau lava o la outou ioe, ioe, ma la outou leai, e leai; ina neʻi faasalaina ai outou.

verses.en: Is any among you afflicted? let him pray. Is any merry? let him sing psalms.
verses.sm: Ua tigaina ea so outou? Ina tatalo ia. Ua fiafia ea se tasi? Ina pese ia.

verses.en: Is any sick among you? let him call for the elders of the church; and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord:
verses.sm: Ua maʻi ea so outou? Ina aami atu ia i toeaina o le ekalesia, ia latou tatalo mo ia, pe a uma ona faauu ia te ia i le suáuu i le suafa o le Alii.

verses.en: And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.
verses.sm: O le tatalo foi e faia i le faatuatua e faaolaina ai le maʻi, e faatuina foi o ia e le Alii; afai foi ua agasala, e faamagaloina ia.

verses.en: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ia fetaʻutaʻuai a outou agasala, ma tatalo le tasi mo le tasi, ina ia faamaloloina outou. Ua aoga tele le tatalo faatauanau a le tagata amiotonu.

verses.en: Elias was a man subject to like passions as we are, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain: and it rained not on the earth by the space of three years and six months.
verses.sm: O Elia o le tagata ia e tusa ma i tatou, ua matuā tatalo o ia ina ia le ua; ona le uaina ai lea o le fanua i tausaga e tolu ma masina e ono.

verses.en: And he prayed again, and the heaven gave rain, and the earth brought forth her fruit.
verses.sm: Ua toe tatalo foi, ona to ifo ai lea o le ua mai le lagi, ona fua mai ai lea o le eleele i ona lava fua.

verses.en: Brethren, if any of you do err from the truth, and one convert him;
verses.sm: Le au uso e, ai se tasi o ia te outou ua sese i le upu moni, a ua faafoi mai se tasi ia te ia,

verses.en: Let him know, that he which converteth the sinner from the error of his way shall save a soul from death, and shall hide a multitude of sins.
verses.sm: ia iloa e ia, o lē faafoi mai le tagata agasala nai lona ala sese, e faaolaina e ia le agaga nai le oti, e ufiufi foi e ia le vao agasala.
